FIBA GDAP: schedule

Source: R/fiba_gdap.R
fiba_gdap_schedule.Rd

Schedule and results of one competition (edition): one row per game.

Endpoint: GET https://digital-api.fiba.basketball/hapi/getgdapgamesbycompetitionid

Usage

fiba_gdap_schedule(comp, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

comp

(integer, required) Required. FIBA competition id (GDAP key space), one per edition: competition.competitionId of any game row (208182 = World Cup 2023, 208722 = Paris 2024 men, 208850 = BCL 2024-25). Find it with fiba_gdap_editions or fiba_gdap_games_between.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw JSON list.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per game. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "fiba_gdap_schedule")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in fiba_gdap_awards().

See also

family_fiba lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(fiba_gdap_schedule(comp = 208182))
